anchors.context: When squealing brakes fail to slow your bicycle, inspect the pads and align them with the wheel rim.
If tires are losing air, find the puncture and patch or replace the inner tube.
Fix rough shifting by adjusting the rear derailleur and cable tension.
For weak stopping power, clean brake pads and check alignment on the wheel.
